act.name: Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019
act.source_name: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways / India Code
act.source_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Government of India
act.description: An Act relating to road safety, motor vehicle insurance, accident compensation, traffic violations, and driving penalties.

sections.title: Protection of Good Samaritans
sections.text: A Good Samaritan shall not be liable for any civil or criminal action for any injury or death of a victim of an accident involving a motor vehicle, where such injury or death resulted from the Good Samaritan's negligence in acting or failing to act while rendering emergency medical or non-medical care or assistance.
sections.plain_language_summary: Bystanders or Good Samaritans who help road accident victims are protected from harassment by police or hospital authorities, and carry zero civil/criminal liability.
sections.source_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
